newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: ATI EYES PORT IN SOUTHERN PHILIPPINES.
newsitem.headline: ATI EYES PORT IN SOUTHERN PHILIPPINES.

text.p: Philippine port operator Asian Terminals Inc (ATI) said on Wednesday it had signed an agreement with local construction firm F. Jacinto Group to study the possibility of constructing a sea port in southern Philippines.

ATI told the Philippine Stock Exchange the study will look into the feasibility of setting up port facilities in Phividec Industrial Estate in Misamis Oriental, a province in the southern Mindanao island.
If found feasible, ATI said it would form a joint venture company with F.Jacinto Group to construct the port.
ATI is the exclusive terminal operator in Manila's South Harbour.
